description: I want to make an application that useful for school students. Interested participants can join our team.
summary: Our goal is to create an interactive 3D environment where users can explore the Moon and Mars, discover abandoned NASA equipment and learn the history of each mission.
details:
SPACE RELICS is an interactive educational platform designed to explore and document abandoned NASA equipment across the Moon and Mars. The project aims to introduce students and space enthusiasts to the historical significance of space exploration hardware through an immersive 3D environment.

Using Three.js, JavaScript and publicly available NASA mission information, the platform allows users to explore planetary surfaces, identify historical mission locations and discover information about equipment left behind after scientific missions.

By combining 3D visualization, historical storytelling and educational content, SPACE RELICS transforms forgotten space hardware into an engaging learning experience.
